author: Frosst10
quote: So you have critics saying there are problems with the game, but it's still a 10/10? Yaaa no, sorry, that's not how a 10/10 game works. The only good thing about this is the graphics thats literally it. The story is garbage. If you put any other game on this game, I wouldn't think it was a GTA game. This game looks like it was made by unity/ubisoft. So if someone who doesn't like this game is an incel and a bigot sorry, but that's not how life works. Its also been proven that Rockstar blacklist critics if they don't give them great scores, but hey, let's listen to them because it fits your agenda. It's not about politics; it's about how terrible this game is outside of the looks. 1/10
